limitations: This is Perivolaropoulos/Skara’s third-party reconstruction and criticism of reduced SH0ES inputs. Its reported Riess clarification supplies no checked producer correspondence, complete original dictionary or generating program. Original zero-based coordinate 44 physical identity/unit and rationale remain unknown despite the reconstruction label X.

The notebook retains 47 entries; the statement “46 if X is ignored” is not an executable reduction. The producer’s zero-width support at coordinate 44 and the reconstruction’s X constraint have distinct statistical roles. No inverse-distance-ladder prior or transition model is adopted.

Literal variants remain: journal residual slope -3.286 versus producer -3.285; journal Delta_b_W versus notebook b_W; notebook N0105/N0976 versus earlier reconstruction N105A/N976A; introduction X uncertainty 10^-9 versus Eq16 ±0.00003; distall README 3292 versus 3492. No repairs or physical aliases are inferred.

The page-8 Y schematic adds the fiducial LMC modulus for HST entries while nearby residual prose describes subtraction. Printed Table A3 and electronic Table E1 have different preview starts. These remain source presentation/reduction ambiguities.

Electronic Table E1’s inspected ranking is within-host. Under the declared top 3130 Y sequence and an explicit ordinal convention, the selected old rows 2630/2744/2745/2754 yield reduced-data witnesses without physical object IDs. All four physical joins remain failed; no tolerance change or new join is justified.

Selected column units and conditional linear covariance formulas do not establish original selection/calibration/reduction ancestry, a physical joint observation likelihood, uncertainty coverage or independent Gaussian row noises. Full table/FITS equivalence, covariance/rank, fits and cosmological interpretation remain unqualified.
